subjects.name: When a member cancels a booking the tee sheet marks the slot as free again and the occupancy shown for that day is refreshed once the booking has gone
Refunds go back to the original payment method after a booking is cancelled and the payment provider confirms the refund before the member receives a receipt
A member can invite a guest by email and each invitation expires after seven days while the member list shows every pending invitation link
When a slot is freed the waitlist promotes the next waiting member in line and notifies them so the tee sheet shows the promoted member in that slot
The occupancy counter shows how many players are booked in each slot of the tee sheet and the starter uses the counter to fill empty slots
Every month the club exports invoices for each paid booking to a CSV file that the treasurer imports into the accounting package with one row per booking
